newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 3.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* In the U.S. the Dow Jones Industrial Average slid to another lower close, shedding 94.04 points to end at 6,517.01.

* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index also lost ground, shedding 6.70 points to 1,181.07. Investors were sidelined while analysing the ramifications of last Friday's central bank annual report on the economy, analysts said.
* Gaming company Genting said it would subscribe for a 64.8 percent stake in Britain's Genting International Plc.
* Malaysia Airlines' success will depend on its ability to control costs, said Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad on Wednesday. But he added that the government would continue to support the company.

* Coachbuilder Kiara Emas makes its debut on the Second Board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange. The company is offering six million shares for sale at 3.00 ringgit each. Mayban Securities said they estimated the fair value of the stock to be around 8.70 ringgit.
